d:
Chhath Puja 2026: kendriy mantri chirag pasvan ne chhath mahaparv ke avsar par chhathi maiya se prarthana ki ki yah sal sabke jivan men khushiyan lekar aae aur unke 'viksit bihar' ke lakshy tatha 'bihar pharst, bihari pharst' ke sankalp ko siddh karne ki shakti pradan karen.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
